methods.name: Stata .dta reader (releases 117, 118, 119; LSF and MSF)
methods.reference: haven::read_dta (haven 2.5.5, ReadStat) on haven-written, Stata-written and byte-level-transformed fixtures; ReadStat's refusals of the patched copies
quantities: numeric values of byte/int/long/float/double (missing codes null)
refusals: <K> = 0, map offsets, observation bound, releases
methods.tolerance: exact (Tol::exact): the reader decodes the same bytes haven decodes

deviations.note: convention (re-scope rule 3): p2a decodes release-117 text as UTF-8 when the bytes are valid UTF-8, else as Windows-1252; haven::read_dta(encoding = NULL) reads every release-117 file as Windows-1252, so haven's own UTF-8 117 files show mojibake there; the pins call read_dta with the encoding that gives the intended text (dta117_haven: UTF-8, dta117_latin1: windows-1252)

deviations.quantity: dtype of byte, int and long
deviations.note: convention (re-scope rule 3): loaded as Int64; haven::read_dta returns doubles; compared after a cast to f64
loaded as plain null; haven keeps the tag (haven::na_tag)
not decoded (Tier 4): cells hold the placeholder "<strL>" with a warning; no fixture holds a strL
not read (Tier 4): haven returns labelled vectors and format attributes, p2a the codes

methods.name: SAS .sas7bdat reader (32/64-bit, both byte orders, uncompressed, RLE, RDC)
methods.reference: haven::read_sas (haven 2.5.5, ReadStat) on haven-written, SAS-written and byte-level-transformed fixtures; ReadStat's reads and refusals of the patched copies; RLE/RDC command tables of ReadStat (hand-built decoder tests)
quantities: numeric values (widths 3-8, both byte orders; NaN null)
refusals: layout fields, unknown page and column types, missing rows, compression
methods.tolerance: exact (Tol::exact): the reader decodes the same bytes haven decodes
